verdict.rationale: PayPal documents extensive REST/GraphQL API coverage mirroring most UI-driven merchant workflows (checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, disputes, platform onboarding, webhooks) plus an agent toolkit/MCP server letting AI agents invoke these same operations via function calling. However, some UI-only paths are explicitly called out (e.g., Resolution Center 'no-code... requires no technical integration', subscriptions dashboard 'recommended if you don't need to integrate into your product UI'), and consumer-app-only features (P2P send money, debit card, savings account) have no documented API equivalents, so full UI/API parity isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: proof that every consumer-facing UI feature (send money, debit card, savings) has an API equivalent, and independent/hands-on confirmation that documented APIs fully replace UI-only flows like the Resolution Center.
